notes: Key page: এক নজরে বরিশাল সিটি (published 2024-03-27): 30 wards, 58 km2, population about 5 lakh (no year), 2011 census 328,278, 3 thanas (not named), 225 mahallas, town committee 1869, municipality 1876, city corporation 2002; a population table 1872-2011. The ward-wise location page is an image only, so wards are numbers 1-30 from the ward count; BMP thana pages list which wards each BMP thana covers (noted per ward). Officials' names (administrator, CEO, past chairmen and mayors) are not copied.
